selection: first training slice containing all labels 0-5 from each of the first three qualifying distinct case groups in the sorted private acquisition inventory
method: compare every compatible original array plane with optional in-plane flips; require unique exact equality of BOTH the image and mask; no label remapping or interpolation
limitations: Three training cases, not exhaustive voxel equivalence across the course dataset.
The overlays are ground-truth comparisons, not model outputs or independent clinical annotation review.
Unit affines and unknown course physical units remain unresolved.
